raceDayDecisionLog.summary: RETAIN WIN — Enamored confirmed non-runner; field now nine. Bath remains good-to-soft (good in places), with light rain and GoingStick 5.1. No automatic upgrade: turf/soft-ground suitability is less proven than recent Tapeta form.

RETAIN WIN (NAP) WITH MARKET-DIVERGENCE WARNING — current multi-bookmaker comparison shows approximately 6/1–15/2, versus original frozen 5/2 reference. This is a substantial unverified-cause drift, not evidence that his known C&D form has disappeared.

WITHDRAWN FROM FRESH EACH-WAY RECOMMENDATIONS (POST-PUBLICATION, original snapshot retained). Later market quotes have widened from frozen 15/2 to approximately 14/1–18/1, while Class 3 opposition, a 7lb rise and stall 10 with pace pressure make the earlier place case insufficiently robust.
RETAIN WIN — Reveur newly confirmed non-runner; ten active runners versus eleven in frozen publication. No confidence upgrade from the removal of an outsider.

Original NB confidence rank withdrawn for fresh prospective use, without changing the frozen WIN selection. Independent field review found underweighted Wardlaw (form 231222, OR77, 8st6lb, Luke Morris; three successive runner-up finishes including Kempton) and Tiernan (AW Class 3/4 placings, RPR101), alongside previously named Circus Of Rome (C&D winner, RPR104) and Oursin (2/3 AW). Ernst Blofeld retains recent form and 5lb claim but has no Newcastle Tapeta experience. No new non-runner in the race; published 7/2 remains within approximate bookmaker comparisons. This is a confidence-rank correction, not a verified probability downgrade or retrospective revision.

7 October 2m4f Worcester second was beaten 11 lengths by Bel Ombre, and the race comment says outpaced before the last. Today's shorter 2m110y and softening ground change the test; Albie Littlewood, Kool Kid and Reinado each have positive recent chase form, despite seasonal layoffs. Retain for observation, not a confident WIN bet.

Two recent fifths, mark 8lb above the September Navan win, and an unconvincing value case after shortening from the overnight quote. Gerrit's Gem, Bad Boy Rizz, Happy Henry and Bay Of Supremacy remain credible. Keep historic selection/quote, but do not recommend a fresh each-way wager.

The three career wins were on good-to-firm. Today's going is good-to-soft and Callianassa has a convincing recent soft-ground York win; Proposal is another serious threat with 12lb less weight than Luna Celeste. Shorter price offers less compensation for genuine uncertainty. Five-runner conditions would make an each-way bet especially unattractive.

His 7 October 7f Class 5 Kempton win came by 2½ lengths, staying on after being mid-division, proving track fitness. Now 6lb higher and back at 6f, with a DIFFERENT jockey: previous winner Taryn Langley, today's Shay Farmer (5lb). Serenity Dream, Initial Blue and Hundred Caps all offer credible six-furlong competition. No NAP; still requires pace/late market check.

Official non-runner at 16:00 Worcester. The eight-runner card now has seven remaining, which reduces standard each-way places from three to two; the overnight each-way rationale is void. Preserve for review only, not a selection.

Last two starts were seconds, including 7f Haydock on soft; stall 3, OR79 and Harry Vigors 5lb claim remain relevant. However the 17-runner field is much stronger than a maiden: Cilician (RPR92), Crowned, Rex Regum, Mobadir, Blessed Voyager and others have winning/improving form. Retain only as a priced each-way possibility, never a strong win call. Confirm bookmaker paid places; do not assume four.

Two 2m Kempton wins from 2025 and a third of 20 in this year's Northumberland Plate give a genuine surface/stamina case. But last run was third of four beaten 36 lengths at Goodwood, and Hot Fuss, Level Look, Codiak, Boatswain and Guildmaster offer formidable Class 2 competition. Only review as a conditional each-way alternative with checked paid places, not a stand-out bet.

Second of fourteen by a neck at Kempton 7f fourteen days ago off OR59, so repeat race conditions and finish strength are sound. Gladiadora now non-runner, reducing field 13→12 without changing standard three-place terms. The horse remains a maiden after 16 runs; Ridger's two wins, Dark Mandate and Penfolds Grange are serious rivals. Retain as E/W rather than WIN with odds/terms check.

Recent 2m2f turf third supports stamina but lacks comparable proof on Kempton's Polytrack in a Class 2 field. Stall 11 and several better-proven AW stayers threaten; now below original 20/1 speculative threshold in observed bookmaker grid. Do not select alongside Synergism.
Official chase going SOFT, while two recent wins were on GOOD. Soft record 0/7 on available historical surface counts, 4 days since last 3m+ win.
Six-pound increase after 7f win, 6f strong specialist opposition; trainer 1/12 and jockey 0/8 in last 14 days. Insufficient standout win advantage.

Racing Post's 21 Oct non-runner bulletin and live racecard mark Under Arrest as NR (7 originally declared -> 6 active). The recent Goodwood runner-up no longer opposes Lots Road; this does not automatically upgrade confidence: Girl Scout, Noble Prince and Akaraka remain credible, and the untried Newmarket 10f with 6lb penalty remains a risk. Met Office forecasts heavy rain during afternoon and gusts around 35-39mph, potentially changing the pace/ground test. Official published going remains Good to Soft (GoingStick 6.4); forecast is not an observed change. Timeform comparison still showed Under Arrest and seven runners at check, so independent feed reconciliation pending. Timeform comparison displayed 11/10 against frozen 11/8, indicative only. Retain conditional WIN research without NAP promotion; recheck ground, runner status and price before off.

rules: Separate rating of on-track win capability, official-result/disqualification probability, and each-way place likelihood; never infer them as identical outcomes.

Positive C&D win at current class/surface, current fitness, and rider claim must be explicitly compared against negative factors before a revocation. Include winning run at prior distance, not only latest performance.

Record each downgrade with a falsifiable critical reason, observed at the time; reject candidates only for a verified material deterioration or clearly superior field, not a speculative scenario alone.
Use trainer/jockey recent form as weak supporting information if sample <20 rides/runs; never sole disqualifier. Require chronological tested evidence before deciding thresholds/weights.
Non-runners, race-day going, EW places and changing early prices trigger fresh comparison; a lower offered price is not evidence that a horse's underlying ability fell.

Store original, review, final active and research-watch cohorts separately and measure winner strike, EW paid place, first-past-post and official settlement separately. Preserve withdrawals and losing cases.
Preserve horse-by-horse factual evidence and uncertainty where pace, sectionals, trainer-course records, and stable intent cannot independently be verified. Avoid trainer-intention inventions.
Shadow-test proposed rules on subsequent new races; no claim of improved accuracy from six outcomes.

rules: Separate rating of on-track win capability, official-result/disqualification probability, and each-way place likelihood; never infer them as identical outcomes.

Positive C&D win at current class/surface, current fitness, and rider claim must be explicitly compared against negative factors before a revocation. Include winning run at prior distance, not only latest performance.

Record each downgrade with a falsifiable critical reason, observed at the time; reject candidates only for a verified material deterioration or clearly superior field, not a speculative scenario alone.
Use trainer/jockey recent form as weak supporting information if sample <20 rides/runs; never sole disqualifier. Require chronological tested evidence before deciding thresholds/weights.
Non-runners, race-day going, EW places and changing early prices trigger fresh comparison; a lower offered price is not evidence that a horse's underlying ability fell.

Store original, review, final active and research-watch cohorts separately and measure winner strike, EW paid place, first-past-post and official settlement separately. Preserve withdrawals and losing cases.
Preserve horse-by-horse factual evidence and uncertainty where pace, sectionals, trainer-course records, and stable intent cannot independently be verified. Avoid trainer-intention inventions.
Shadow-test proposed rules on subsequent new races; no claim of improved accuracy from six outcomes.
